tools.description:
Reads ONE incoming supplier invoice and returns a job id for polling.

Use when: the user has a single invoice (PDF, photo, scan, XML e-invoice or QR bill) and wants supplier, invoice number, dates, amounts, VAT or line items extracted.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description:
Shows how many scanned pages are left on the prepaid balance for this API key.

Use when: before a batch of scans or photos, or when parse_invoice answered insufficient_balance and the remaining amount must be confirmed.
Do not use when: the user asks about invoice content — that is get_result.

tools.name: topup_link
tools.description:
Returns the page where the prepaid balance can be topped up, plus the minimum amount.

Use when: the balance is empty or too low for the documents the user wants to process.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_result, topup_link · Private data: parse_invoice, get_result, get_balance, topup_link · Public sink: parse_invoice, get_balance · Destructive: get_balance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_result, topup_link · Private data: parse_invoice, get_result, get_balance, topup_link · Public sink: parse_invoice, get_balance · Destructive: get_balance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "parse_invoice" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
